notes:
Describes something that evokes a sense of deep mystery, spiritual wonder, or the supernatural. Stronger and more elevated than simply ⟦{不思議|ふしぎ}→不思議：02358_fushigi⟧ (strange/mysterious), carrying connotations of sacred or transcendent mystery.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {神秘的|しんぴてき}な⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧: mystical atmosphere
- {神秘的|しんぴてき}な⟦{体験|たいけん}→体験：11443_taiken⟧: mystical experience
- {神秘的|しんぴてき}な⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧: mysterious power
- {神秘的|しんぴてき}な{美|うつく}しさ: mysterious beauty
- {神秘的|しんぴてき}な⟦{存在|そんざい}→存在：03326_sonzai⟧: enigmatic being

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{不思議|ふしぎ}→不思議：02358_fushigi⟧: mysterious, strange — more casual and everyday; can describe puzzling things without spiritual connotations
- ⟦{幻想的|げんそうてき}→幻想的：25756_gensouteki⟧: fantastical, dreamlike — emphasizes an unreal, dreamlike quality rather than spiritual mystery
- ⟦{神聖|しんせい}→神聖：13735_shinsei⟧: sacred, holy — focuses on sacredness and purity rather than mystery

ETYMOLOGY:
Composed of ⟦{神秘|しんぴ}→神秘：13734_shinpi⟧ (divine mystery) + ⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧ (adjectival suffix). {神|しん} means god/divine, and {秘|ひ} means secret/hidden.

definitions.explanation: having a quality of deep mystery or spiritual wonder that is beyond ordinary understanding; evoking a sense of awe or the supernatural

examples.japanese: {神秘的|しんぴてき}な⟦{光|ひかり}→光：01707_hikari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えた→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{湖|みずうみ}→湖：00867_mizuumi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{神秘的|しんぴてき}な⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: That lake has a mystical atmosphere.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夜空|よぞら}→夜空：09591_yozora⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がる→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧オーロラ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{神秘的|しんぴてき}な{美|うつく}しさだった。
examples.english: The aurora spreading across the night sky had a mystical beauty.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古代|こだい}→古代：05324_kodai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{遺跡|いせき}→遺跡：09527_iseki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{神秘的|しんぴてき}な⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{宿|やど}っている→宿る：12351_yadoru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{信|しん}じられている→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧。
examples.english: It is believed that a mystical power resides in the ancient ruins.
